De reliquis audiatur Montacutius. antidia. p. 17.
Ego certe (inquit) cum Constantino, reliquias illas fafciis
involvam, auro includam circumgestandas, admovebo
labiis, ac collo fuspensas manibus oculisque crebro usurpa-
tas intuebor, vel in apothecas condam & recludam inter-
pretiosissima cimelia cenfendas. Veneratione relativa
exemplo veteris ecclesiæ colendas esse dicit idem.
ibid. pag. 16. Neque peregrinationem religiosam ad lo-
ca fancta improbandam esse, ibid. pag. 44. item deni-
que omnem de reliquijs inter partes bodie, esse de lana
caprina, & asini umbra. idem, in Origin. p. 45.
De sanctorum demortuorum adoratione, docent;
Sanctos esse orationis & interceffionis mediatores
apud Deum. Montacut. antidiat. pag. 20. ideoque
sanctorum festa à se celebrari, ut eorundem interceffionis
participes esse possint. Lancelotus Andreas in ftrictu-

taxari, si quis oraverit; Sancte angele custos ora pro me.

page.notes: The page is a little worn on the left edge, and the edge of the neighbouring page shows as a dark strip. Two Greek words are doubtful: "σκιομαχίαν" is read from a worn print and marked [?]. The word "reginam" is split across the line end; the catchword "ginam," is printed at the foot. The printed spelling "Santos" is not used: the text reads "Sanctos". The printed "Vbi afferit" is kept as printed, and the spelling of "Controversiam" follows the print. Printed spellings in "fitu" and "fqualore" are kept.
